evidence.observation: The timber terrace reads as a structurally important lateral element extending farther along the facade than the previous 2.3 m candidate; the visible front portion begins near the masonry exterior assembly and continues to the rear end of the house.

The timber terrace is visibly continuous behind the masonry exterior assembly. The correction extends only the longitudinal footprint needed to preserve that overlap/continuity; no exact metric length is claimed.

platform_updates.statement: Conservative minimum longitudinal extension: keep the existing rear termination at y=9.0 m, move only the inferred front edge from y=6.7 m to y=6.0 m, and increase depth from 2.3 m to 3.0 m. The 3.0 m depth is a revisable Scene inference chosen as the smallest clear visual correction, not a measured terrace length.

inference_notes: Only the longitudinal footprint of platform-timber-1 is changed.
Its z level, outward projection, thickness, host relation, edge treatments, material and rear termination remain unchanged.
The front support follows the moved front edge mechanically, keeping the same 0.25 m inset; the rear support remains unchanged.
No geometry of the masonry landing, partial wall, stair, openings, terrain or main house is changed.
